No scope extension to arbitrary factory inputs, replaced response origins, modified serializers, active adversaries or unreviewed adapters.
scopeRequirements.census: Keep frozen315 corpus IDs/bytes/oracles unchanged. Label these two obligations STATIC_DOMAIN_EXCLUSION and UNEXECUTED_NATIVE; arbitrary-input behavior stays UNSUPPORTED/HELD. Never count them as native PASS or claim all original section8 negatives ran. If a separate MODEL row is exercised, report that separately as MODEL evidence and do not let it discharge the excluded native obligation.
scopeRequirements.mandatoryEvidence: Actual ordinary OFF/ON native GET with exact residence/manifest/direct route, original actor/bridge/entry/finalizer, status/body/ALL-header differential and marker on the genuine mutable B. All other required reachable nominated finalizer/collision/transport negatives and the separately qualified retention component remain mandatory and cannot be waived by this two-case addendum.

censusRule: These TWO native obligations remain UNEXECUTED_NATIVE / STATIC_DOMAIN_EXCLUSION / UNSUPPORTED_GENERIC. A separately executed MODEL row is counted only as MODEL. Frozen315 inputs/IDs/oracles unchanged; no all-obligations-executed/native PASS claim.
